roots.fix: Original host records immutable literal notStarted proof after matching Run, attempt, fence and worker. A separately authorized new work request may start; continue and duplicate goal cannot dispatch.

roots.problem: Cleanup completed but exit facts could not be persisted; original host knew exit while store did not.
roots.fix: Retain original-host process-local observation. Explicit recovery may persist the same observed facts and settle without execution. New hosts cannot manufacture these facts.

roots.problem: A user change committed with a never-started native request was not present in native message history.
roots.fix: Pass the literal previously authorized but unsubmitted change data with the new authorized request; preserve requirement revision and native baseline. No replay of old commands, Review prompt, or responsibility additions.
